ndcfb41d868f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about hazards and their settings in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Cyclones and storm surge affect mainly the coastal areas
Floods affect the Godavari and Krishna deltas
River floods occur mainly in the post-monsoon period
ndcfb41d868f.x: River floods occur mainly during the South-West Monsoon, not the post-monsoon period. The other three hazard-setting links are correct.

ndisaster-management-12-14.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
ndisaster-management-12-14.x: Seismic microzonation is a non-structural earthquake-mitigation measure, so that pair is wrong. The other three are correctly matched.

ndisaster-management-11-6.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: NDMA – Search, rescue and relief operations
Central Water Commission – Flood forecasting network across India
Brahmaputra Board – Flood and erosion control in the North-East
NDRF / SDRF – Search, rescue and relief operations
ndisaster-management-11-6.x: NDMA frames policy guidelines and coordination; search, rescue and relief are done by NDRF/SDRF.

n48d1bcb341b.s: Which of the following region–main hazard pairs of Andhra Pradesh is wrongly matched?
o: Coastal Andhra – Cyclones, storm surge, floods and coastal erosion
Rayalaseema and southern Prakasam – Chronic drought and groundwater depletion
Inland plains – Cyclones and storm surge
n48d1bcb341b.x: The main hazard of the inland plains is rising heat waves; cyclones and storm surge are the hazards of Coastal Andhra.

n9baebf2c7f3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the NDMA Cyclone Guidelines, 2008?
o: Multipurpose cyclone shelters are a structural measure
Raised platforms are a structural measure
Storm-surge barriers are a non-structural measure
All-weather evacuation roads are a structural measure
n9baebf2c7f3.x: Storm-surge barriers are listed as a structural cyclone-mitigation measure, along with shelters, raised platforms and evacuation roads.

ndisaster-management-12-4.s: Which of the following hazard–mitigation pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Flood – Embankments, dams and channel improvement
Cyclone – Multi-purpose coastal embankments and cyclone shelters
Drought – Check dams, farm ponds and irrigation
Landslide – Check dams, farm ponds and irrigation
ndisaster-management-12-4.x: Landslides are met with retaining walls and slope stabilisation; check dams and farm ponds are drought measures.

n4647f6d7936.s: Lambasingi, the coldest place and 'Kashmir of AP', is in which district?
n4647f6d7936.x: Lambasingi, where temperatures fall to about 2 deg C, is in Alluri Sitharama Raju (ASR) district, not Kurnool.

n28dc3ee6657.s: Phase I of the National Cyclone Risk Mitigation Project (NCRMP) was aided by:
n28dc3ee6657.x: NCRMP Phase I was World Bank-aided and covered Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.

nd88d2adf290.s: In India, flood management is a ____ subject.
nd88d2adf290.x: Flood management is a State subject; the Centre gives technical guidance and promotional funds through FMBAP.

n8297d9c8c7b.s: After the MHA remeasurement (Dec 2024), the coastline of Andhra Pradesh is about:
n8297d9c8c7b.x: The remeasured coastline of Andhra Pradesh is 1,053.07 km, third in India after Gujarat and Tamil Nadu.

nindian-geography-16-9.s: Interior Maharashtra, interior Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu are important:
nindian-geography-16-9.x: All five are important rain-shadow areas.

na77c792a9ec.s: During winter (January–February), temperatures in Andhra Pradesh are generally between:
na77c792a9ec.x: The AP winter is mostly dry, with temperatures generally between 13 C and 30 C.

ndisaster-management-8-6.s: The Manual for Drought Management was revised in:
ndisaster-management-8-6.x: The Drought Manual was revised in 2016; NDMA's drought guidelines came in 2010.

nf26dc7305f4.s: The Diviseema cyclone struck Andhra Pradesh in:

n46368f6f12f.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the summer season extends approximately from:
n46368f6f12f.x: AP has a generally hot and humid climate, with summer from March to June.

n2aaa3bb1e8b.s: The Andhra Pradesh Disaster Management Rules were framed in:
n2aaa3bb1e8b.x: The AP Disaster Management Rules, 2007, with the Disaster Management Act, 2005, provide the State's framework.

nc5f4628e92e.x: Michaung made landfall near Bapatla; Montha hit the Kakinada coast and Hudhud devastated Visakhapatnam.

ndisaster-management-12-17.s: Which of the following is a structural drought-mitigation measure?
ndisaster-management-12-17.x: Irrigation works are structural; drought-resistant crops, water conservation and PMFBY insurance are non-structural.

nap-geography-13-5.s: In Andhra Pradesh, south-west monsoon rainfall peaks in:
nap-geography-13-5.x: The south-west monsoon runs mid-June to September and peaks in July.

ndisaster-management-11-4.s: The Rashtriya Barh Ayog (National Flood Commission) was set up in:
ndisaster-management-11-4.x: The Rashtriya Barh Ayog was set up in 1976 and submitted its report in 1980.

n3e1a217a35a.s: The handling of which cyclone is cited as an example of proactive risk governance in Andhra Pradesh?
n3e1a217a35a.x: In Hudhud, rapid transmission of IMD alerts to district administrations combined with preparedness made it an example of proactive risk governance.

ndisaster-management-8-3.s: The 2016 Manual for Drought Management judges drought using a ____ approach.
ndisaster-management-8-3.x: Because rainfall deficit alone misses impacts, the 2016 Manual uses rainfall plus crop, vegetation, soil-moisture and hydrology indicators.

n54c5cce9c6a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about APFDC plantations?
o: Coffee plantations are in Visakhapatnam and East Godavari
Clonal eucalyptus occupies the largest plantation area
Cashew plantations are confined to Visakhapatnam and the East Godavari agency
Cashew is grown on the Guntur-Prakasam-Nellore coast
n54c5cce9c6a.x: APFDC cashew is on the Guntur-Prakasam-Nellore coast and in East Godavari, West Godavari and Chittoor, so it is not confined to the agency.

n9d066397332.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the mangroves of Andhra Pradesh?
o: The Godavari-Krishna estuaries are called India's second-largest mangrove ecosystem
By ISFR mangrove-cover area, AP ranks second in India after West Bengal
By mangrove-cover area, AP is second on the east coast
By ISFR mangrove-cover area, Gujarat ranks above AP
n9d066397332.x: By ISFR mangrove-cover area, AP ranks behind West Bengal, Gujarat and Andaman & Nicobar, not second in India.

nindian-geography-50-5.s:
Assertion (A): Alpine forests occur in the Himalayas at around 3,000–4,900 m.
Reason (R): Coniferous forests occur on Himalayan slopes at about 1,500–3,000 m.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nindian-geography-50-5.x: Both statements are correct altitude facts, but the coniferous belt at lower altitude does not explain why alpine forests occur higher up.

n1d3d5185304.s: Red sanders is listed in which Appendix of CITES?
o: It is not listed in CITES
n1d3d5185304.x: Red sanders is in CITES Appendix II; it is also IUCN Endangered and in Schedule IV of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.

nap-geography-13-11.s: Short thorn forests occur in areas receiving annual rainfall of:
nap-geography-13-11.x: Short thorn forests occur below 70 cm; dry deciduous forests need 75–100 cm and moist deciduous 125–200 cm.

nap-geography-19-5.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh has the highest forest area?
nap-geography-19-5.x: YSR Kadapa has the most forest area and Krishna the least; Nallamala is the biggest forest.

nindian-geography-50-15.s: Sundari is the characteristic tree of:
nindian-geography-50-15.x: Sundari is the typical tree of tidal (littoral) forests.

nc660d0ec8f4.s: Approximately what share of Andhra Pradesh's notified forest area is Reserved Forest?
nc660d0ec8f4.x: The notified forest area is about 85.8% Reserved, 13.6% Protected and 0.6% Unclassed.

n799883c222c.s: APFDC acts as the government's agent for exporting:
o: Red sanders wood and beedi leaf
n799883c222c.x: APFDC exports red sanders wood and beedi leaf; GCC buys minor forest produce and TRIFED runs the MSP for MFP.

n418267119e4.s: Which agency is the nodal agency for the minimum support price (MSP) for minor forest produce?
n418267119e4.x: TRIFED is the nodal agency for MSP for MFP; the Girijan Co-operative Corporation buys minor forest produce from tribals.

nap-geography-14-17.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Kolleru WLS – Freshwater lake in Eluru district
Gundla Brahmeswaram WLS – Freshwater lake in Eluru district
Rollapadu WLS – Grassland habitat of the Great Indian Bustard
nap-geography-14-17.x: Gundla Brahmeswaram lies in the Nallamala forests between the Krishna and Penna; the Eluru freshwater lake is Kolleru.

nbe65b25293c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Papikonda National Park?
o: A Reserved Forest was established there in 1882
It was declared a National Park in 1978
It was declared a Wildlife Sanctuary in 1978
It is associated with the Godavari gorge through the Papikonda hills
nbe65b25293c.x: Papikonda became a Wildlife Sanctuary in 1978 and a National Park only in 2008.

n00d08261c7a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the mangroves of Andhra Pradesh?
o: They grow mainly in the estuaries of the Vamsadhara and Nagavali
Large-scale afforestation in deltaic mangroves dates from the Sixth Five-Year Plan
ISFR 2023 places Gujarat second, though State surveys call AP's the second-largest
Coringa WLS and Krishna WLS protect them
n00d08261c7a.x: AP's mangroves are in the Godavari and Krishna estuaries (Coringa and Krishna WLS), not the Vamsadhara-Nagavali.

nap-geography-11-4.s:
Assertion (A): The Seshachalam hills around Tirumala hold the Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve.
Reason (R): The Palakonda hills mark the southern extent of Andhra Pradesh.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nap-geography-11-4.x: Both are true, but the Palakonda hills marking AP's southern extent has nothing to do with the Seshachalam hills holding the biosphere reserve.

nc71f9e38651.s: The boundary of a National Park can be altered only on the recommendation of the:
nc71f9e38651.x: Alteration of a National Park's boundary requires the recommendation of the National Board for Wildlife; grazing is not permitted inside.

n199c4d7c8c9.s: Jerdon's courser is protected in which wildlife sanctuary of Andhra Pradesh?
n199c4d7c8c9.x: Jerdon's courser, a critically endangered nocturnal bird, is protected in Sri Lankamalleswara WLS.

nd91b6d8c9ed.s: India's largest tiger reserve by area is:
nd91b6d8c9ed.x: NSTR is India's largest tiger reserve by area and by core habitat, and per the State survey AP's only tiger reserve.

n07618466685.s: The Nallamala Hills extend through which region of Andhra Pradesh?
n07618466685.x: Nallamala extends through Nandyal, Prakasam and Palnadu; Seshachalam is in Tirupati–Annamayya and Palakonda in Kadapa–Annamayya.

n9c496ff829d.s: Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam was declared a tiger reserve in:
n9c496ff829d.x: NSTR, in the Nallamala hills along the Krishna, was declared a tiger reserve in 1983.

na16cfe781bf.s: The smallest wildlife sanctuary of Andhra Pradesh is:
na16cfe781bf.x: Nelapattu (4.58 sq km) is the smallest sanctuary; Rollapadu is 6.14 sq km.

n0678fcba0dc.s: Uppalapadu is in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
n0678fcba0dc.x: Uppalapadu is in Guntur; Telineelapuram and Telukunchi are in Srikakulam.

nap-geography-14-4.s: The Indira Gandhi Zoological Park is located in:
nap-geography-14-4.x: Indira Gandhi Zoological Park is in Visakhapatnam, not Tirupati.

nap-geography-14-18.s: Sri Lankamalleswara Wildlife Sanctuary is located in:
nap-geography-14-18.x: Sri Lankamalleswara sanctuary is in Kadapa (Cuddapah); Nelapattu is in Tirupati district.

nap-geography-19-9.s: In Andhra Pradesh, dry deciduous forests are associated mainly with the:
nap-geography-19-9.x: Dry deciduous forests cover the Seshachalam–Nallamala belt, and the forest region reaches south to the Palakonda and Nallamala hills.

n8d22c6fc533.s: As per the AP Socio-Economic Survey 2024-25, how many wildlife sanctuaries does Andhra Pradesh have?
n8d22c6fc533.x: AP has 13 wildlife sanctuaries, 3 national parks, 4 deer parks and 2 zoological parks.

nfc328f98475.s: Sri Venkateswara National Park lies inside:
nfc328f98475.x: Sri Venkateswara NP lies inside Sri Venkateswara WLS in the Seshachalam and Tirumala hills.

n3ec3fea96c0.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the moist or tidal forest belt occurs in areas receiving rainfall of:
n3ec3fea96c0.x: The moist or tidal belt receives 125–200 cm; dry deciduous forests get 75–100 cm and thorn forests the lowest rainfall.

n74adf66cf9d.s: Krishna Wildlife Sanctuary is located in which districts?
n74adf66cf9d.x: Krishna WLS lies in Bapatla and Krishna districts and protects the Krishna estuary mangroves.

n47d911d2d49.s: Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve is managed by which forest circle?
n47d911d2d49.x: NSTR is managed by the Srisailam circle; its AP core areas lie in Nandyal, Prakasam and Palnadu.

nc180d68541d.s: Tiger reserves in India are managed on a core-buffer model under the:
nc180d68541d.x: Tiger reserves follow a core-buffer model under the NTCA, in accordance with the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.

n0d942b6857e.s: The only elephant sanctuary of Andhra Pradesh is:
n0d942b6857e.x: Koundinya is AP's only elephant sanctuary; Seshachalam is its first and only biosphere reserve.

n099c0282b45.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the distribution of soils?
o: Alluvium is India's most widespread soil, covering 45.6% of the country
Karnataka has mostly black soil, followed by red soil
Red soil is the dominant soil type in Andhra Pradesh
Alluvium covers about 6% of Andhra Pradesh
n099c0282b45.x: Karnataka has mostly red soil, followed by black soil.

n4db6a235934.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the red soils of Andhra Pradesh?
o: They form mainly from weathered granite, gneiss, Dharwar schists and greenstones
Their red colour is mainly due to ferric oxides
They are generally poor in nitrogen, phosphorus and organic matter
n4db6a235934.x: Red soils have low moisture-retention capacity.

nap-geography-23-6.s: Which of the following agro-climatic zone pairs of Andhra Pradesh is wrongly matched?
o: North Coastal Zone – Includes Vizianagaram district
Godavari Zone – Godavari delta and adjoining areas
High Altitude and Tribal Areas Zone – Eastern Ghats
nap-geography-23-6.x: Vizianagaram is in the North Coastal Zone; the Southern Zone includes parts of Kadapa district.

nfbfb50deece.s: Which of the following area–soil damage pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Anantapur and Sri Sathya Sai – Desertification and wind erosion
Uppada – Topsoil loss through Podu cultivation
ASR and Parvathipuram Manyam – Topsoil loss through Podu cultivation
nfbfb50deece.x: Uppada suffers coastal erosion from sea-level rise and waves; Podu-related topsoil loss is in ASR and Parvathipuram Manyam.

nindian-geography-19-28.s: Coffee, rubber and cashew are typically grown on ____ soil.
nindian-geography-19-28.x: Laterite soil grows coffee, rubber and cashew; red soil grows millets, pulses and groundnut.

na7d216e7d01.s: The black soils of Andhra Pradesh are poor in:
na7d216e7d01.x: Black soils are rich in calcium, potash and magnesium but poor in nitrogen, phosphorus and humus.

nap-geography-23-4.s: Which agro-climatic zone of Andhra Pradesh covers drought-prone Rayalaseema with low and erratic rainfall?
nap-geography-23-4.x: The Scarce Rainfall Zone is drought-prone Rayalaseema with low and erratic rainfall.

n8d92585fd28.s: Black (regur) soil, the second-largest soil group of Andhra Pradesh, covers about ____ of the State.
n8d92585fd28.x: Black soil covers about one-fourth (25 per cent) of AP, not 45 per cent.

n02520047b79.s: The laterite soils of Andhra Pradesh are rich in:
n02520047b79.x: Laterite soils are rich in hydrated iron and aluminium oxides but poor in organic matter, so their fertility is low.

n52ca6daf01e.s: Which red-soil sub-type covers the largest share (about 30 per cent) of Andhra Pradesh?
n52ca6daf01e.x: Red earth with loamy subsoil covers 30 per cent; red soil with clay base 12, red loamy 9 and red sandy 8 per cent.

nindian-geography-19-29.s: The Krishna delta lies in which region?
nindian-geography-19-29.x: The Krishna delta lies around Vijayawada and Machilipatnam; the Godavari delta around Rajahmundry and Kakinada.

n090ad9d159a.s: Which of the following is NOT a cause of soil degradation in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Heavy chemical use in the Guntur chilli belt
Periodic deposition of fresh river silt in the deltas
n090ad9d159a.x: Fresh flood silt renews deltaic alluvium; it does not degrade the soil.

nap-geography-23-9.s: Which of the following is a major crop of the Scarce Rainfall Zone of Andhra Pradesh?
nap-geography-23-9.x: Groundnut, sunflower, sorghum and castor are its crops; coconut, coffee and rubber need humid coastal or hill conditions.

n613bbc1b72d.s: Coffee and pepper are major crops of which agro-climatic zone of Andhra Pradesh?
o: High Altitude and Tribal Areas Zone
n613bbc1b72d.x: Coffee and pepper belong to the High Altitude and Tribal Areas Zone, not the Southern Zone.

nindian-geography-19-14.s: Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal and Assam are widely covered by ____ soil.
nindian-geography-19-14.x: Alluvial soil is widely found in all six of these States.

n1aafb14c295.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the local term 'Chalka' denotes:
n1aafb14c295.x: Chalka denotes red sandy soil; Regur is black cotton soil and Bhangar is old alluvium.

n41c7669da20.s: Under Rainfed Area Development in Andhra Pradesh, assistance per farm family is:
n41c7669da20.x: Rainfed Area Development gives Rs 30,000 per farm family.

nindian-geography-19-27.s: Which soil is 'self-ploughing' and develops cracks on drying?
nindian-geography-19-27.x: Black soil is self-ploughing and cracks on drying.

n1b13f9b1005.s: The deltaic alluvial soils of Andhra Pradesh are laid down by which rivers?
n1b13f9b1005.x: The Godavari and Krishna lay down the deltaic alluvium, renewed with silt in each flood; it is rich in potash and lime.

n8c20f46859b.s: The saline soils of the Rayalaseema plateau, with high lime and salt, are generally:
o: The most fertile soils of the State
n8c20f46859b.x: Saline soils of the Rayalaseema plateau contain much lime and salt and are generally unfit for cropping.

n30df7f844d3.s: Deep black soils in Andhra Pradesh occur at:
n30df7f844d3.x: Deep black soils occur at Adoni and Alur; black soils cover about 25 per cent of AP.

nindian-geography-19-16.s: Sugarcane, jute, maize, oilseeds and fruits and vegetables are all suited to ____ soil.
nindian-geography-19-16.x: All five crops suit alluvial soil.

n7c6c9896c73.s: Village-wise nutrient mapping and soil-sample analysis are functions of:
n7c6c9896c73.x: Soil Health Cards give soil-sample analysis and village-wise nutrient mapping so farmers know their soil's nutrient status.

nbc54fcfa80a.s: The black soils of Andhra Pradesh are derived from Deccan Trap basalt, crystalline schists and:
nbc54fcfa80a.x: AP's black soils come from Deccan Trap basalt, crystalline schists and basic gneiss.

nindian-geography-19-31.s: Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Karnataka are major areas of ____ soil.
nindian-geography-19-31.x: All four are major black-soil areas.

nap-geography-23-5.s: Nellore, Chittoor and Tirupati belong to which agro-climatic zone of Andhra Pradesh?
o: High Altitude and Tribal Areas Zone
nap-geography-23-5.x: Nellore, Chittoor and Tirupati are in the Southern Zone; the High Altitude Zone is hilly and grows millets, coffee, pepper and tubers.

nap-geography-20-5.s: In Andhra Pradesh, rice is mainly grown on:
nap-geography-20-5.x: Rice, like sugarcane, is mainly grown on delta alluvium, not the red soils of Rayalaseema.

nindian-geography-19-5.s: Alluvial soil is generally poor in:
nindian-geography-19-5.x: Alluvium is rich in potash, phosphoric acid and lime but poor in nitrogen and humus; it is ideal for rice and wheat.

nindian-geography-19-19.s: Black soil gets its colour mainly from compounds of:
nindian-geography-19-19.x: Black soil is clayey and gets its colour from iron- and titanium-related compounds.

nap-geography-15-3.s: The fertile delta alluvium of the Krishna–Godavari–Penna–Vamsadhara region mainly supports:
nap-geography-15-3.x: Fertile delta alluvium with water supports thirsty crops such as rice and sugarcane.

n1c7b9488061.s: Very deep black soils of the Deccan Plateau are found in its:
n1c7b9488061.x: Very deep black soils are in the north-western Deccan and become medium, thin and shallow towards the east and south.

nf465ab4f36f.s: In Andhra Pradesh, red soils are widely distributed in:
nf465ab4f36f.x: Red soils are widespread in Rayalaseema (Anantapur, Sri Sathya Sai, Kadapa, Nandyal, Kurnool) and also occur in coastal uplands.

nindian-geography-19-18.s: Black soil is particularly suitable for cotton because of its:
nindian-geography-19-18.x: Black soil holds moisture for long, which suits deep-rooted, dry-season cotton.

nba832bd498e.s: Much of Andhra Pradesh is underlain by ____ bedrock.
nba832bd498e.x: Granitoid-gneiss bedrock underlies much of AP, though other formations and deposited soils also occur.

na5d0ec5304b.s: Laterite soils form through intense leaching under conditions of:
na5d0ec5304b.x: High temperature and heavy rainfall cause intense leaching of silica and lime, forming laterite.

nindian-geography-19-11.s: The red colour of red soil is due to:
nindian-geography-19-11.x: Iron oxides spread through the soil give red soil its colour.

n48bb3f6106a.s: The red soils of Rayalaseema are characteristically:
o: Shallow, with low moisture retention and low organic matter
Deep, moist and rich in organic matter
n48bb3f6106a.x: Rayalaseema's red soils are shallow, with low moisture retention and low organic matter.

nindian-geography-19-24.s: Laterite soil does NOT develop in:
nindian-geography-19-24.x: Laterite needs high temperature and heavy rainfall for intense leaching, so it does not form in the arid Thar.

nbf13f7f4cae.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about mineral occurrences in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Diamonds occur in Krishna district and the Cuddapah-Vindhyan formations
Iron ore in the State is mostly haematite
Heavy-mineral beach sands are confined to the Nellore coast
Asbestos is associated with the Cuddapah system of YSR Kadapa
nbf13f7f4cae.x: Heavy-mineral beach sands run from the Srikakulam coast to the Krishna coast, so they are not confined to Nellore.

nee147e2523b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about mica in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The principal mica belt is the Gudur–Nellore belt
AP ranks second in India in mica production after Rajasthan
Muscovite is white, phlogopite amber and biotite black
Mica was declared a minor mineral in 2015
nee147e2523b.x: AP ranks first in mica production (70.2%) and reserves (40.5%); Rajasthan is second.

n8f4f16c81bc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about critical minerals in Andhra Pradesh?
o: NGRI reported rare earth elements in syenite rocks of Anantapur district
Statewide mineral mapping was ordered, with value addition through APMDC
Titanium and lithium are among the focus minerals of the mapping
NGRI reported rare earth elements in syenite rocks of Srikakulam district
n8f4f16c81bc.x: The REEs were found in syenite rocks of Anantapur district; Srikakulam is known for beach sands.

neb66616572a.s:
Assertion (A): Chilli Red stone is associated with Anantapur.
Reason (R): Steatite is associated with the Cuddapah system of Kadapa.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
neb66616572a.x: Both are correct mineral-location facts, but steatite in Kadapa does not explain Chilli Red stone in Anantapur.

n910fd34590c.s: Which river basins are important in northern Andhra Pradesh?
n910fd34590c.x: Vamsadhara and Nagavali are the northern basins; Godavari, Krishna and Pennar are the State's major basins.

ne95df3eb1e7.s: JHBDPL is the pipeline of which project?
ne95df3eb1e7.x: JHBDPL is the Pradhan Mantri Urja Ganga pipeline under One Nation One Gas Grid.

nap-geography-1-4.s: Apatite in Andhra Pradesh occurs at:
nap-geography-1-4.x: Apatite occurs at Kasipatnam in erstwhile Visakhapatnam; asbestos is at Pulivendula and mica in the Gudur belt.

nap-geography-28-4.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the Deccan Trap rocks are found in:
nap-geography-28-4.x: The Deccan Trap is in Prakasam and Guntur; Archaean rocks are in Srikakulam and Eluru, and the Kurnool system in Kadapa and Kurnool.

n1d5f57d8745.s: Uranium in Andhra Pradesh is associated with:
n1d5f57d8745.x: Uranium is at Tummalapalle; copper, zinc and silver are at Agnigundala and Bondalamottu.

n39366a44e7a.s: Tatipaka in Andhra Pradesh is known for:

n321b695771d.s: Which of the following is NOT part of the Krishna-Godavari basin?
n321b695771d.x: Barmer-Sanchore is in Rajasthan; the other three are KG-basin areas.

ne574112da64.s: Black Galaxy (black granite) of Andhra Pradesh comes from:
ne574112da64.x: Black Galaxy is from the Chimakurthy–Prakasam (Ongole) belt; Srikakulam Blue is from Srikakulam and Kashmir White from Visakhapatnam.

n816e1ebc367.s: Coal in the Godavari valley is associated with which formation?
n816e1ebc367.x: Godavari valley coal belongs to the Gondwana formation; the Dharwar formation holds the Nellore mica schist belt.

nebfb1416cd1.s: Chromite in Andhra Pradesh is associated with:
nebfb1416cd1.x: Chromite is from the Kondapalli hills; manganese is in Vizianagaram and mica in the Gudur belt of Nellore.

nap-geography-6-4.s: Diamonds in Andhra Pradesh come from:
nap-geography-6-4.x: Diamonds come from Vajrakarur in Anantapur; wolframite is from Buruguwada and chromite from Kondapalli.

nap-geography-28-5.s: The Deccan Trap is associated with ____ rocks.
nap-geography-28-5.x: The Deccan Trap is basalt; the Kurnool system has sandstone, shale and limestone.

nddcde750cde.s: Which district ranks first in iron ore production in Andhra Pradesh?
nddcde750cde.x: Anantapur ranks first in iron production; Kurnool ranks first in limestone.

nap-geography-6-5.s: Ramagiri, known for gold reserves, is in which district?
nap-geography-6-5.x: Gold is found at Ramagiri in Anantapur; copper in old Guntur and Kadapa, lead in old Kurnool.

nb081166e98a.s: Planned manganese processing clusters in Andhra Pradesh are associated with:
nb081166e98a.x: Manganese clusters are planned in Vizianagaram, while port-based mineral processing is planned along the coast.

n288ea043c7a.s: The Girijan Cooperative Corporation (GCC) of Andhra Pradesh is headquartered at:
n288ea043c7a.x: GCC, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, buys minor forest produce from tribals at fair prices.

n52146e3368d.s: In India, minor minerals such as building stone, gravel, clay and sand are regulated by:
n52146e3368d.x: Minor minerals are regulated by the States; major minerals in the First Schedule of the MMDR Act, 1957 are under the Centre.

nbf5841d565b.s: Which State is the top producer of limestone in India?
nbf5841d565b.x: Rajasthan is the top producer, followed by Madhya Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh; Karnataka holds about 25–28% of reserves.

n807c406c0c4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Trewartha's classification of Indian climates?
o: It modified Koeppen's scheme, keeping its temperature-rainfall logic
It classified climates mainly by vegetation and altitude, rejecting temperature and rainfall
Caw (Ganga plain) corresponds broadly to Koeppen's Cwg
H (Himalaya) corresponds broadly to Koeppen's Dfc/E
n807c406c0c4.x: Trewartha did not reject temperature and rainfall; he modified Koeppen with the same temperature-rainfall logic, simplified for India.

n08a37bdeb21.s: Which of the following energy measures under the AP SAPCC 2025-30 is NOT correctly stated?
o: Raising renewables to 40% of the energy mix
Two green hydrogen hubs of 60 MW
n08a37bdeb21.x: The target is 1 lakh EV charging stations, not 10 lakh.

nfc15548cf2b.s: India's climate adaptation spending in FY 2022 was estimated at about ____ of GDP.
nfc15548cf2b.x: Adaptation spending was 5.6% of GDP in FY 2022; SAPCCs moved from mitigation (2010–15) to district-level adaptation from 2020.

na3951cfcced.s: The WMO placed 2025 at about ____ above the pre-industrial level.
na3951cfcced.x: WMO placed 2025 at about 1.43 C above pre-industrial; 2015-2025 were the eleven warmest years.

nap-geography-13-12.s: Which region of Andhra Pradesh receives 125–200 cm of rainfall?
nap-geography-13-12.x: The north coast and agency get 125–200 cm; Kadapa–Kurnool 75–100 cm and the Rayalaseema interior under 70 cm.

need5e0740a8.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the eight missions of the National Action Plan on Climate Change?
need5e0740a8.x: The eight NAPCC missions are Solar, Enhanced Energy Efficiency, Sustainable Habitat, Water, Himalayan Ecosystem, Green India, Sustainable Agriculture and Strategic Knowledge; there is no nuclear mission.

na532d3e615f.s: In Thornthwaite's moisture regions of India, the rain-shadow interior Deccan is:
na532d3e615f.x: The rain-shadow interior Deccan is semi-arid; western Rajasthan and Kutch are the arid end.

nf54f13d1383.s: How many agro-climatic zones does Andhra Pradesh have?
nf54f13d1383.x: AP has six agro-climatic zones, including the Scarce Rainfall Zone (Kurnool and Anantapuramu).

na86f9a67ccc.s: Andhra Pradesh lies approximately between the latitudes:
na86f9a67ccc.x: AP has a tropical monsoon climate and lies approximately between 12°41'N and 19°07'N.

o: Tropical rainforest of the west coast and North-East
ncd46f6583ef.x: Am is tropical rainforest of the west coast and North-East; Aw is the Peninsula, BS/BW steppe and desert, Caw the Ganga plain.

nbe9e2cc3cfb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the distribution of world population?
o: About 90% of humanity lives on about 10% of the land
The Ganges-Brahmaputra delta is among the most densely populated areas
Most people live in the mid-latitudes of the Southern Hemisphere
East Asia and South Asia are the two major dense population clusters
nbe9e2cc3cfb.x: Most people live in the Northern Hemisphere mid-latitudes and the tropics of Asia, not the Southern Hemisphere.

ne6ecf015bb7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Thomas Malthus's An Essay on the Principle of Population was published in 1798
The Population Bomb was written by Thomas Malthus
Paul R. Ehrlich's The Population Bomb appeared in 1968
The Population Bomb opens: "The battle to feed all of humanity is over"
ne6ecf015bb7.x: The Population Bomb (1968) was written by Paul R. Ehrlich; Malthus wrote the 1798 Essay.

nafd3cea80eb.s: India accounts for about ____ of the world's population.
nafd3cea80eb.x: India has 17.7% of world population on only 2.4% of world area.

nd0d4f50b6d4.s: The two major dense population clusters of the world are:
nd0d4f50b6d4.x: East Asia (eastern China, Japan) and South Asia (Ganga plains, Bangladesh delta) are the two major clusters.

nf961249acdb.s: How many of the world's ten most populous countries are in Asia?
nf961249acdb.x: Six of the top ten are in Asia, not Africa; together the ten hold about 60% of humanity.

n61ae71326d8.x: The 2, 3, 5 and 7 billion milestones came in 1927, 1960, 1987 and 2011.

n7fffc880efc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about AP's Draft Population Management Policy (5 March 2026)?
o: It aims to raise the State's TFR from 1.9 to 2.5
It aims to lift the State's TFR from 1.5 to 2.1
It proposes Rs 30,000 for a third child and Rs 40,000 for a fourth
It reflects AP's DTM stage 4 and a shift to 'Pillale Sampada'
n7fffc880efc.x: The draft aims to lift AP's TFR from 1.5 to 2.1, not from 1.9 to 2.5.

nf49231cde44.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about world urbanisation?
o: The older UN DESA series put the urban share at about 55%
Under the WUP 2025 method, cities hold about 45% of the world's ~8.2 billion people
WUP 2025 names Tokyo the world's largest city
WUP 2025 names Jakarta the world's largest city
nf49231cde44.x: WUP 2025 names Jakarta the largest city, followed by Dhaka, Tokyo and New Delhi.

nad26802b684.s: Which of the following pairs (natural growth rate, SRS 2024) is INCORRECTLY matched?
nad26802b684.x: Kerala had the lowest natural growth rate, 3.9 per 1,000; 20.8 is Bihar's, the highest.

n8e7cc42f4ed.s: SRS 2024 places India's total fertility rate at:
n8e7cc42f4ed.x: SRS 2024 gives 1.9 and NFHS-6 gives 2.0, both below the replacement level of 2.1.

n170f2db4a2c.s: The world average total fertility rate is about:
n170f2db4a2c.x: The world average TFR is 2.2; the USA's is 1.6.

nb8b4f900989.x: Actual growth = natural increase (births minus deaths) plus net migration.

n6d08f13c0cb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the BIMARU States?
o: They have historically lagged in several development indicators
They are described as youthful States with high fertility
Bihar has the highest TFR among them
Their growth has no connection with the delimitation debate
n6d08f13c0cb.x: Their faster population growth is connected with the delimitation debate.

n4200ec8e1b4.s: Under the Census Town criteria, at least ____ of the male working population must be in non-farm work.
n4200ec8e1b4.x: A Census Town needs 5,000 people, a density of 400 per sq km and 75% male non-farm workers, criteria unchanged since 1981.

n6a4a8117771.s: Physiological density is total population divided by:
o: Total geographical area of the State
n6a4a8117771.x: Physiological density = total population / net cultivated area; arithmetic density uses total area.

nindian-geography-36-5.s: The smallest Union Territory of India by area is:
nindian-geography-36-5.x: Lakshadweep is the smallest UT; Goa is the smallest State by area and Mahe the smallest district.

n72d9f6f8664.s: Which State had the second-largest share of India's population in 2011?
n72d9f6f8664.x: The order was Uttar Pradesh (16.49%), Maharashtra (9.29%), Bihar (8.58%) and undivided AP (7.00%).

n22068096244.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's population-explosion phase (1951–1981)?
o: Mortality fell rapidly while fertility remained high
Average annual growth was about 2.2 percent
Migration played no part in the growth of this phase
Migration from Tibet, Bangladesh, Nepal and Pakistan added to growth
n22068096244.x: Migration from Tibet, Bangladesh, Nepal and Pakistan added to growth in this phase.

n70a2ff43526.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about constitutional provisions connected with Census 2027?
o: The 84th Amendment is linked to the delimitation freeze until the first census after 2026
The 106th Amendment is linked to the delimitation freeze until the first census after 2026
The 106th Amendment is associated with women's reservation
Article 334A is connected with the women's reservation framework
n70a2ff43526.x: The delimitation freeze is linked to the 84th Amendment; the 106th Amendment concerns women's reservation.

nc284390ddf2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's share of world population?
o: At Census 2011, India held about 17.5% of world population
UN WPP 2024 puts India at 17.7% of world population
India's 17.7% share sits on about 2.4% of the world's surface area
India overtook China as the most populous country in April 2021
nc284390ddf2.x: India overtook China in April 2023, not April 2021.

ne666af8ffea.s:
Assertion (A): The population density of Andhra Pradesh (304) is lower than India's average (382).
Reason (R): AP's population more than doubled from about 233 lakh in 1961 to 495.77 lakh in 2011.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ne666af8ffea.x: Both are true Census 2011 facts, but the doubling of AP's population does not explain why its density is below India's average.

n7feb4745a17.s: India's decadal population growth during 2001–11 was about:
n7feb4745a17.x: Decadal growth was 17.7%, down 3.9 points from 21.54% in 1991-2001, the sharpest fall since Independence.

nf2f1d3b4546.s: The first complete and synchronous census of India was held in 1881 under:
nf2f1d3b4546.x: The 1881 census under Lord Ripon was the first complete, synchronous one; the 1872 census under Lord Mayo was non-synchronous.

n2db383865ae.s: In Census 2011, the 0–6 child population formed about ____ of India's total population.
n2db383865ae.x: The 0–6 population was 1,644.15 lakh, about 13.6% of the total, and showed the first absolute fall in decades.

n338be671916.s: The reference date for the regular population enumeration of Census 2027 is:
n338be671916.x: House listing is in April–September 2026, enumeration in February 2027, with 1 March 2027 as the reference date.

n6fd42d46505.s: In Census 2027, the caste question will be:
n6fd42d46505.x: Census 2027 is the first caste count beyond SC/ST since Independence, and its caste column is open-ended.

n42553d86d80.s: Which was the only State with negative decadal population growth in 2001–11?
n42553d86d80.x: Nagaland (about -0.6%) was the only negative State; Meghalaya (about 27.9%) recorded the highest growth.

nab51cb8b519.s: The decadal growth of India's Scheduled Tribe population (2001–11) was:
nab51cb8b519.x: ST growth of 23.66% was higher than the overall growth of 17.69%.

n19a17b31798.x: The motto was "Our Census, Our Future"; Census 2011 was the 15th census, with reference date 1 March 2011.

ne53a1c4282e.s: The population census in India is conducted under the:
ne53a1c4282e.x: The census is conducted under the Census Act, 1948; census is Union List Entry 69 under Article 246.

nap-geography-17-4.s: The urban population share of Andhra Pradesh in 2011 was:
nap-geography-17-4.x: AP's urban share was 29.47% and its female literacy 59.96% in 2011.

n725c89fe965.s: Which State had the largest 0–6 child population in Census 2011?
n725c89fe965.x: The order was Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.

nd8eef79ed8b.s: How many questions were notified for Census 2027?
nd8eef79ed8b.x: Census 2027 has 40 questions, including 13 new ones; Census 2011 had 29.

n7a5047746c5.s: The minimum population for a settlement to be classed as a Census Town is:
n7a5047746c5.x: A Census Town needs at least 5,000 people, a density of 400 per sq km and at least 75% of male workers outside agriculture.

n59f82a665b0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the peak of India's demographic dividend?
o: ES 2018-19 placed it around 2041, with about 59% aged 20-59
ES 2025-26 placed it around 2030, with about 65% aged 15-59
Both Economic Surveys placed the peak around 2041
n59f82a665b0.x: The two Surveys differ: ES 2018-19 said about 2041 and ES 2025-26 about 2030.

nadc9b992a82.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the elderly in India?
o: Kerala and Tamil Nadu are among the most aged States
About 18.7% of elderly women live alone
About 78% of elderly persons have pension cover
About 70% of elderly persons depend on others
nadc9b992a82.x: About 78% of elderly persons have no pension cover.

n52ba0429186.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's ageing profile?
o: Its median age is lower than India's
Its under-14 share is projected to fall from 25% (2011) to 15% (2036)
Its 60+ share is projected to reach 19% in 2036
Its 60+ share is projected to reach 23% in 2047
n52ba0429186.x: AP's median age is 32.5 years, higher than India's 28.

na174bc0f10f.s: India's family planning programme was renamed the Family Welfare Programme in:
na174bc0f10f.x: It was renamed in 1977, after the Emergency (1975-77) and its coercive mass sterilisation.

neba4d0370d9.s: The UNFPA India Ageing Report 2023 was prepared in association with:
neba4d0370d9.x: UNFPA prepared it with IIPS; its findings include feminisation, ruralisation, regional variation and old-age poverty.

n3c4e4af1dbb.s: The replacement-level total fertility rate is:
n3c4e4af1dbb.x: A TFR of 2.1 keeps population stable across generations; births per 1,000 population a year is the crude birth rate, not TFR.

n99c1b6facff.s: As per SRS 2024, which recorded the lowest total fertility rate (1.2)?
n99c1b6facff.x: Delhi had the lowest TFR at 1.2; India's TFR was 1.9 (rural 2.1, urban 1.5).

n6107da6a176.s: In NFHS-5, the contraceptive prevalence rate of Andhra Pradesh was:
n6107da6a176.x: AP's CPR was 71.1% against India's 66.7%; AP's TFR is 1.5 with a goal of 1.8.

n1f52674c771.s: The total fertility rate of India in NFHS-5 was:
n1f52674c771.x: NFHS-5 recorded 2.0, down from 2.2 in NFHS-4 and below the replacement level of 2.1.

nd9635a74421.s: India's median age is projected to reach 40 years by:
nd9635a74421.x: India's median age is cited as 24 in 2011, 36 by 2036 and 40 by 2051.

n6d4f8dfebcd.s: In the Marxian view, overpopulation is a product of:
n6d4f8dfebcd.x: Marxists see overpopulation as a product of capitalism, expressed through relative surplus population and unemployment.

nab220173061.s: In the Quality of Life for Elderly Index, which led the Union Territories?
nab220173061.x: Chandigarh led the UTs, Rajasthan ranked first among aged States and Mizoram led the North-East.

n9db60462ce8.s: As per NFHS-6 (2023–24), how many of 36 States/UTs had a TFR below 2.1?
n9db60462ce8.x: NFHS-6 gives India's TFR as 2.0, urban TFR 1.6, and 31 of 36 States/UTs below replacement.

n3fe521c0a20.s: India during 1951–81 is an example of which stage of the demographic transition model?
n3fe521c0a20.x: Stage 2 has high birth rates, falling death rates and population explosion, as in India in 1951–81.

n1f4dc244555.s: Which of the following is classified as a youthful State?
n1f4dc244555.x: Bihar and Uttar Pradesh are youthful States; Kerala is ageing and Telangana intermediate.

n675d6ec2339.s: The demographic dividend window in India:
o: Opens at different times in different States
Depends only on the old-age dependency ratio
Ends as soon as the birth rate falls
n675d6ec2339.x: It opens at different times in different States because their demographic transitions proceed at different rates.

n81915c3e86a.s:
Assertion (A): The sex ratio of residual Andhra Pradesh was 997 in the 2011 Census-based data.
Reason (R): The adult sex ratio reported in the health table was 996.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n81915c3e86a.x: Both figures are correct, but a separate adult sex ratio figure does not explain the overall sex ratio of 997.

n55097bc3369.s: The Supreme Court described the gender bias behind India's adverse sex ratio as:
n55097bc3369.x: Son preference and patriarchal norms sustain a gender bias the Court called deep-seated even though conditions have improved.

n5f39d466f97.s: Which State had the lowest sex ratio in Census 2011?
n5f39d466f97.x: Haryana had 879; Kerala had the highest (1,084) and Daman and Diu the lowest among UTs (618).

ne31015352c7.s: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao was launched on 22 January 2015 at:
ne31015352c7.x: BBBP was launched at Panipat, Haryana, to reverse the falling child sex ratio.

n4e1d84940aa.s: The biological norm of sex ratio at birth is about ____ girls per 1,000 boys.
n4e1d84940aa.x: More boys are normally born, so the biological norm is about 950 girls per 1,000 boys.

n2c77fbe2589.s: NFHS-5, a household survey, reported India's sex ratio as:
n2c77fbe2589.x: NFHS-5 reported 1,020, which is not directly comparable with the Census 2011 figure of 943.

na51184306e4.s: India's sex ratio in Census 2011 was:
na51184306e4.x: It rose from 933 in 2001 to 943 in 2011; it had fallen from 972 in 1901 to 945 in 1941.

n4d1a0b37902.s: The sex ratio of Andhra Pradesh in Census 2011 was:

n49aacf1fcc0.s: India's child sex ratio in 2001 was:
n49aacf1fcc0.x: The child sex ratio was 927 in 2001 and about 918–919 in 2011 (914 provisional).

n294aff25604.s: In India, sex ratio is expressed as:
n294aff25604.x: India uses females per 1,000 males; the international (UN) convention uses males per 100 females.

nb0b862717b8.s: Rural sex ratio in India is generally higher than urban sex ratio mainly because of:
o: Higher birth rate of girls in towns
Sex-selective migration of men to towns
nb0b862717b8.x: Male-selective migration to towns raises the share of females in rural areas and lowers the urban sex ratio.

nbe30e326c6f.s:
Assertion (A): On the 28-district map (2011 data), Alluri Sitarama Raju has the lowest literacy rate, 44.67 per cent.
Reason (R): In the 13-district era, West Godavari was the most literate district of Andhra Pradesh.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nbe30e326c6f.x: Both are correct, but West Godavari's old rank does not explain ASR's low literacy.

nbf1129f5921.s: ULLAS (New India Literacy Programme) targets non-literates aged:
nbf1129f5921.x: ULLAS, a Centrally Sponsored Scheme (2022-23 to 2026-27), targets non-literates aged 15 and above.

nf31c0426f06.s: The National Education Policy, 2020 introduced which curricular structure?
nf31c0426f06.x: NEP 2020, which replaced NPE 1986 after 34 years, adopted the 5+3+3+4 structure.

n76d01943a7e.s: India's first totally literate district (1990) was:
n76d01943a7e.x: Ernakulam was the first totally literate district through the Total Literacy Campaign; Kottayam was the first fully literate town (1989).

n930afceb209.s: Which State had the largest gender gap in literacy in Census 2011?
n930afceb209.x: Rajasthan had the largest gap, about 28 points, against a national gap of about 16 points.

nae9f32a093b.s: The literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh in Census 2011 was:
nae9f32a093b.x: AP's literacy was 67.35% in 2011 and 71.40% in PLFS 2025, below the all-India rate.

nbfb8c4de4de.s: Which group faces the largest literacy deficit in India?
nbfb8c4de4de.x: Rural women face the largest deficit; rural literacy (68.9%) lagged urban (85.0%) in Census 2011.

n846108c1f73.s: AP's ULLAS implementation focuses on SHG members, school cooks and helpers, night watchmen and:
n846108c1f73.x: The AP focus groups are SHG members, school cooks and helpers, night watchmen and anganwadi ayahs.

n1a0073ad01c.x: Literacy rose from 18.33% in 1951 to 74.04% in 2011.

n18a129335a5.s: In the NSS 75th round (2017-18), which State had the lowest female literacy?
n18a129335a5.x: Rajasthan had the lowest female literacy (the APPSC-GS 2022 trap is UP); India's literacy was 77.7%.

nf6aa91f1680.s: The National Literacy Mission was launched in:
nf6aa91f1680.x: The order was Farmers' Functional Literacy Programme (1967-68), NAEP (1978), National Literacy Mission (1988) and Saakshar Bharat (2009).

n0abc585a5b0.s: The first State to attain full literacy (2025) was:
n0abc585a5b0.x: Mizoram was first in 2025, followed by Goa and Sikkim; Uttarakhand became the sixth in July 2026.

n27517f546cc.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: MGNREGA – Up to 100 days of wage work per rural household a year
PMEGP – Merger of PMRY and REGP
n27517f546cc.x: PMEGP's nodal agency is KVIC, not NABARD.

n19033cf2692.s: Under Current Weekly Status, a person is counted as employed if he or she worked for at least ____ on any day of the reference week.
n19033cf2692.x: CWS counts one hour of work on any day of the reference week as employment.

n69f0e3c2720.s: Under UPSS, a person is counted as employed if he or she worked for at least ____ in the year.
n69f0e3c2720.x: UPSS counts 30 or more days of work in the 365-day reference year as employment.

n3456e8fbc9f.s: In 2011, main agricultural labourers formed about ____ of Andhra Pradesh's main workers.
n3456e8fbc9f.x: AP had 86.12 lakh main agricultural labourers out of 193.17 lakh main workers, about 45%.

nbfaf00f570e.s: The overall Work Participation Rate of India in Census 2011 was:
nbfaf00f570e.x: The overall WPR was 39.8% (male 53.3%, female 25.5%); about 60% were non-workers.

n5e92de48bf2.s: In Census 2011, marginal workers formed about ____ of India's total workers.
n5e92de48bf2.x: Of 4,818.89 lakh workers, main workers were 75.2% and marginal workers 24.8%.

n48c5f726e61.s: In the Census, a main worker is one who worked for at least ____ in the reference year.
n48c5f726e61.x: A main worker worked 183 days (six months) or more in the reference year.

nacf6dc5e473.s: As per PLFS 2023–24 (usual status, all ages), the LFPR of Andhra Pradesh was:
nacf6dc5e473.x: AP's LFPR was 47.5% and WPR 45.6%, above India's 45.1% and 43.7%.

n45082475e2b.s: In Census 2011, women formed about ____ of India's agricultural labourers.
n45082475e2b.x: Women were 55% of agricultural labourers but only 24% of cultivators, and held 12.8% of operational holdings.

ne07a4fc02ee.s: India's female LFPR (aged 15 and above) in 2017–18 was:

necad73005d0.s: As per PLFS 2023-24, the female LFPR of Andhra Pradesh is:
necad73005d0.x: AP's female LFPR is 35.8%, above India's 31.7%, yet urban young women (15-29) have a WPR of only 15.9%.

na3c280481ab.s: In 2011–12, agriculture employed about ____ of India's workers.
na3c280481ab.x: Agriculture employed about 48.9% and services about 27% of workers in 2011–12.

n56996ed0067.s: In rural India, Scheduled Castes are concentrated mostly among:
n56996ed0067.x: Scheduled Castes are largely marginal farmers and landless agricultural labourers.

nde06c82d639.s: In Q2 of FY 2025–26 (July–September 2025), agriculture's share of total employment in India was:
nde06c82d639.x: Agriculture had 42.4% of employment, self-employment 55.8% and casual labour 18.9%.

n1b8267620c8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the rural–urban distribution of Scheduled Castes in 2011?
o: About 76% of SCs lived in rural areas
About 24% of SCs lived in urban areas
SCs formed about 18.5% of India's urban population
SCs formed about 18.5% of India's rural population
n1b8267620c8.x: SCs formed about 12.6% of the urban population; 18.5% is their share of the rural population.

n8d67f831f89.s: In Census 2011, the Scheduled Caste share of Punjab's population was about:
n8d67f831f89.x: Punjab had about 31.9% SCs, Himachal Pradesh 25.2% and West Bengal 23.5%; Mizoram only about 0.1%.

n7b15d011f1b.s: Which Constitutional Amendment removed SC seat reservation in the panchayats of Arunachal Pradesh?
n7b15d011f1b.x: The 83rd Amendment (2000) did this because Arunachal Pradesh is wholly tribal.

nd674bdb28ab.s: The Scheduled Caste infant mortality rate (2018) was ____, against 32 nationally.
nd674bdb28ab.x: SC infant mortality was 44 against 32 nationally; SC unemployment was 5.5% against 5%.

ndab1e4b3b3c.s: Buddhists were made eligible for Scheduled Caste status in:
ndab1e4b3b3c.x: SC status covers Hindus, Sikhs (added 1956) and Buddhists (added 1990); Jains are not included.

n8dd63e605b7.s: Some north-eastern and island territories have no notified Scheduled Caste population because their populations are:
n8dd63e605b7.x: Their people are overwhelmingly tribal, while SC status is tied to untouchability in the Hindu caste order.

n37eaa288f16.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: The Kaka Kalelkar Commission (1953) was set up under Article 340
The U.N. Dhebar Commission (1960-61) was the first Article 339 commission
The Dilip Singh Bhuria Commission (2002-04) was the second Article 339 commission
The Virginius Xaxa Committee (2013) was set up by the Planning Commission
n37eaa288f16.x: The Xaxa high-level committee was set up by the PMO, not the Planning Commission.

nc33a9fd94d1.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Article 342 – National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
Article 338A – National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
nc33a9fd94d1.x: Article 342 lets the President notify STs after consulting the Governor; the NCST is created by Article 338A.

n2b001ae33ed.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Verrier Elwin Committee – Multi-Purpose Tribal Development Blocks
Dilip Singh Bhuria Committee – Criteria for defining Scheduled Tribes
U.N. Dhebar Commission – Tribal conditions and land alienation
Lokur Committee – Criteria for defining Scheduled Tribes
n2b001ae33ed.x: The Dilip Singh Bhuria Committee is linked to the PESA Act, 1996; ST criteria were set by the Lokur Committee.

n8f69318ed02.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Sentinelese?
o: They live on North Sentinel Island
Their island has been a tribal reserve since 1956
Like the Shompen, they are classified as Mongoloid
A 3-nautical-mile prohibited zone surrounds their island
n8f69318ed02.x: The Sentinelese are Negrito like the Jarawa and Onge; only the Shompen of Great Nicobar are Mongoloid.

n0d50f38fa77.s:
Assertion (A): The Toda and Kota tribes are associated with the Nilgiris.
Reason (R): The Muria and Maria tribes are associated with Bastar.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0d50f38fa77.x: Both are correct tribe–region links, but Bastar's tribes do not explain the Toda and Kota being in the Nilgiris.

n6d0036c2000.s: Santali, Ho and Mundari belong to which language group?
n6d0036c2000.x: Santali, Ho and Mundari are Austro-Asiatic; Toda, Kota and Gondi are Dravidian.

n85e3cb19d86.s: Bihar was dropped from the proviso to Article 164(1) by the:
n85e3cb19d86.x: The 94th Amendment dropped Bihar and added Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand, alongside MP and Odisha.

nac487add99b.s: The Chenchu, Koya and Konda Reddi belong to which regional tribal group?
nac487add99b.x: They form the southern group; Bhil, Mina and Warli are western and Khasi, Garo and Naga north-eastern.

n2179b3df8a4.s: The ceiling on land recognised under the Forest Rights Act, 2006 is:
n2179b3df8a4.x: The ceiling is 4 hectares; occupation must predate 13 December 2005.

nfae55de9f56.s: The Lokur Committee was set up in:
nfae55de9f56.x: Lokur was 1965, the Bhuria Committee 1995, the Dilip Singh Bhuria Commission 2002 and the Xaxa Committee 2013–14.

nac889714cef.s: The Sahariya tribe is found mainly in:
nac889714cef.x: The Sahariya live in Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan, not Kerala.

nb0c60492780.x: The Baiga are from MP, the Chenchu from AP, the Toda from Tamil Nadu and the Great Andamanese from A&N.

n617d1732f8d.s: The Gadda Brahmin community was added to the ST list of Jammu and Kashmir in:
n617d1732f8d.x: Gadda Brahmin was added in 2024 with the Pahari and Paddari groups; the Sippis were added in 1991.

n4f8ec41f2eb.s: The Bhils are associated with the:
n4f8ec41f2eb.x: Bhils live in the Aravalli-Vindhya-Satpura belt; Santhals in the Santhal Parganas, Gonds in Gondwana and Bastar, Todas in the Nilgiris.

n1adc67eda56.s: How many Scheduled Tribe communities does Andhra Pradesh have?
n1adc67eda56.x: AP has 34 ST communities and 12 PVTGs (shared with Telangana); it is a Fifth Schedule State.

nbdb04f3ff64.s: Eklavya Model Residential Schools are modelled on the:
nbdb04f3ff64.x: EMRS follow the Navodaya model; the target is 740 schools.

nindian-geography-7-1.s: The Pahadi Korba tribe is found in:
nindian-geography-7-1.x: The Pahadi Korba live in Jashpur; the Bharia are in Chhindwara and the Chenchu in the Nallamala.

n928839737a3.s: The sex ratio of India's Scheduled Tribes in Census 2011 was:
n928839737a3.x: The ST sex ratio was 990; STs numbered 10.43 crore (8.6%), about 89.97% of them rural.

n29de7accdb2.s: The proposed ST (Valley) tier in Assam was recommended by:
n29de7accdb2.x: A Group of Ministers proposed it (report, Nov 2025) for six communities including Tai Ahom and Tea Tribes; tribal bodies opposed it.

nfd63f1a94ce.s: The ghotul youth dormitory is associated with the:
nfd63f1a94ce.x: The ghotul belongs to the Gonds; the Bhil name comes from 'billu' (bow).

nindian-geography-21-4.s: Which State had the highest child sex ratio (972) in Census 2011?
nindian-geography-21-4.x: Arunachal Pradesh had 972; Kerala had the highest overall sex ratio and Haryana the lowest.

nce9479d0360.s: Longpi pottery is associated with the:
nce9479d0360.x: Longpi pottery is Tangkhul Naga; pukhor embroidery is Toda and the ghotul and Sulur flute are Gond.

n747d510dc95.s: The Scheduled Areas of Andhra Pradesh form about ____ of the State's area.
n747d510dc95.x: They cover 16,267.63 sq km, 10.15% of AP's area, across five districts.

nbd37eda0c0d.s: Adi Vaani, India's first AI translation platform for tribal languages, was launched under the:
nbd37eda0c0d.x: Adi Vaani was launched under the Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan and covers Bhili, Gondi, Mundari and Santali.

n1fde5b1fdae.s: The largest PVTG of India is the:
n1fde5b1fdae.x: The Sahariya are the largest PVTG; the Sentinelese and Great Andamanese are the smallest.

n54a0a5128d4.s: Among the 10 PESA States, which has only draft PESA rules?
n54a0a5128d4.x: Rules are framed in 9 of the 10 States; Odisha has only draft rules.

nf4750540a38.s: The Changpa nomads of Ladakh have been recognised as a Scheduled Tribe since:
nf4750540a38.x: The Changpa of the Changthang plateau, who rear pashmina goats and yaks, have had ST status since 1989.

nddad3f1be27.s: The Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan aims to develop how many grassroots leaders?
nddad3f1be27.x: It aims for 20 lakh leaders across 1 lakh villages, linked to Tribal Village Vision 2030.

nf880ead3859.s: PM-JANMAN covers how many Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups?
nf880ead3859.x: PM-JANMAN covers 75 PVTGs with 11 interventions during 2023-24 to 2025-26.

n07ecea5bc46.s: The Korku tribe is associated with the:
n07ecea5bc46.x: The Korku live in the Satpura–Melghat region of MP and Maharashtra; the Tharu are in the Terai and the Kadar in the Anamalai Hills.

ncb419b569a6.s: The Onge, a Negrito PVTG, live on:
ncb419b569a6.x: The Onge are of Little Andaman; the Shompen are in Great Nicobar and the Sentinelese on North Sentinel Island.

ndcd9c67a90a.s: The last tribe in India to practise head-hunting was the:
ndcd9c67a90a.x: The Konyak Naga were the last head-hunters; the Tangkhul Naga are known for Longpi pottery.

n7511119a528.s: Under PESA, 1996, Scheduled Tribes get at least ____ of the seats in panchayats.
n7511119a528.x: STs get at least 50% of seats, and every chairperson must be an ST.

nindian-geography-7-4.s: The Mikir (Karbi) tribe lives mainly in:
nindian-geography-7-4.x: The Mikir (Karbi) live in Assam, mainly in Karbi Anglong; the Dafla are in Arunachal Pradesh.

n6592e9d625d.s: Primitive Tribal Groups (PTGs) were renamed PVTGs in:
n6592e9d625d.x: 52 PTGs were declared in 1975, 23 added in 1993, the name changed to PVTGs in 2006, and seven variants added in February 2024.

nindian-geography-21-5.s: The second-largest Scheduled Tribe group of India is the:
nindian-geography-21-5.x: The Bhil are largest, the Gond second and the Santhal third; MP has the largest ST population.

nindian-geography-9-5.s: The cattle-rearing Maasai pastoralists are found in:
o: Kenya, northern Tanzania and eastern Uganda
nindian-geography-9-5.x: The Maasai are cattle-rearing pastoralists of Kenya, northern Tanzania and eastern Uganda.

nindian-geography-7-21.s: The Kadar tribe are forest dwellers of the:
nindian-geography-7-21.x: The Kadar live in the Anamalai hills of Kerala; the Irula live in the Nilgiris and northern Tamil Nadu.

n76f0797fd0d.s: As per the latest official figure, how many notified Scheduled Tribe groups are there in India?
n76f0797fd0d.x: The latest figure is 705 notified ST groups in 30 States/UTs; older references cite 698.

na0b8248c0c4.s: The Santhals revere ____ as Marang Buru.
na0b8248c0c4.x: The Santhals revere Parasnath Hills as Marang Buru; the Nilgiris are associated with the Todas.
